I’ll find where trace deletion parses the ID list, trim whitespace around each ID, and add a focused regression test. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill.
Updated trace deletion to strip leading and trailing whitespace from each comma-separated ID, so `"a, b"` behaves like `"a,b"`.

Added regression coverage for spaces, tabs, and newlines. All three focused cases passed; pytest then exited with a sandbox permission error in its process-inspection summary hook.

No dependencies installed or full suite run.
